resources.string: Joystick LED must be turned on in device settings. Supported on devices like AYN Odin and AYN Thor.
To restore the original LED color, toggle the joystick LED setting off and on in the device menu.
The app detects your last played game and creates a library entry for it.
Enter your RetroAchievements username and Web API key to use last played game from the API. Recommended for helper devices (tablets, phones) when the game is not launched on the same device.
Get your Web API key from the Authentication section at RetroAchievements Settings.
Uses your Steam and/or RetroAchievements credentials to detect your last played game. Configure credentials in Settings → Achievements.
Select a play history source to enable last played game detection.
Select the ES-DE parent folder (default: Internal Storage/ES-DE).
Select folder for last played detection
Neither RetroArch nor ES-DE folder is set. Choose which folder to set up.
Automatically detects when a game is launched and switches to it. For devices that don\'t run games locally, use Achievements instead and press Refresh manually.
Automatically create a game entry when a launched game has no matching one. When off, only existing games are focused.
Shows your last played game when the app starts or returns to the foreground. New games are created automatically when Auto-Create Games is on.

Display Game Twin on top of all apps, with your guide, images and achievements one tap away. Fold it down to a small handle whenever you want the whole screen back.\n\nAndroid needs your permission to draw over other apps.
Game Twin handle. Tap to open Overlay Mode, hold to return to the app.
Tap to open Game Twin over this screen. Hold to switch screen.
Show Game Twin over your game. Great for dual screen games. Tap the handle to hide it and tap again to bring it back.
